annotations.title: Find a flour in Loafy's list

description: Find the exact flour a baker used, by brand and name or its barcode, among the flours of Loafy's list and the baker's own: each with its grain, how whole it is, its strength, the word on its bag and the token log_bake and update_bake take in flours ("flour:<id> 400"). A flour nobody listed is logged as its grain with the word on the bag, such as "whole rye 100". Needs the baker's Loafy account.

query.description: Brand and name as on the bag, such as "Caputo Pizzeria" or "King Arthur bread flour", or its barcode.

name: find_flours
